title: Roveia (v2)
description: Clean clinical light: a white page, near-black ink (#101010), one bright brand blue (#218aff) for CTAs and the blue half of headlines, pale grey cards (#eee), translucent ink chips, a sky-blue glow for gradients. Manrope throughout at regular weight with tight display tracking; 24px card radius.
notes: light is the faithful mode; dark is a near-black sibling with charcoal cards and the same blue
secondary is the charcoal of the steps panel in both modes' dark scope; highlight is a peach used only for a soft corner glow
Manrope Variable is the original's own face (open licence)
name: roveia-v2-theme
